functions.name: MakeGeometry
functions.signature: MakeGeometry(Target, In Parent Geometry, In Child Offset, In Local Size)
functions.docs: Performs the same functionality as FGeometry::MakeChild, without the need for the original Widget reference.

functions.name: UpdateFromSlot
functions.signature: UpdateFromSlot(Target, In Slot Index, In Slot)
functions.docs:
Applies the given slot's values to this proxy.
Will return true if any values have changed from those stored.
If CompareArranged is true, the "changed" flag is only true if the new DesiredSize doesn't match the previous ArrangedSize, rather than previous DesiredSize.

functions.name: GetIndex
functions.signature: GetIndex(Target, In Slot, In Default Value)
functions.docs:
A wrapper for accessing slot parameters for a given SlotType. Not all SlotTypes support all parameters.
Optional default values are used when the wrapped SlotType cannot provide the requested property (ie. FSlot doesn't provide it's index).

functions.name: GetWidget
functions.signature: GetWidget(Target, In Slot)
functions.docs: Get the contained widget. This should always be valid, and return SNullWidget by default.

functions.name: GetVisibility
functions.signature: GetVisibility(Target, In Slot, In Default Value)
functions.docs: Get the current visibility state of the slot.

functions.name: GetPadding

functions.docs: Get the slot padding.

functions.name: GetDesiredSize
functions.signature: GetDesiredSize(Target, In Slot, In Default Value)
functions.docs: Get the slot's desired size as it was last calculated.

functions.name: GetArrangedSize
functions.signature: GetArrangedSize(Target, In Slot, In Default Value)
functions.docs: Get the slot's arranged size as it was last calculated.

functions.name: GetSizeRule
functions.signature: GetSizeRule(Target, In Slot, In Default Value)
functions.docs: Get the slot's applied size rule, ie. Auto, Fill.

functions.name: GetSizeValue
functions.signature: GetSizeValue(Target, In Slot, In Default Value)
functions.docs: Get the slot's size value, applicable if the size rule is Fill or FillContent.

functions.name: GetShrinkSizeValue
functions.signature: GetShrinkSizeValue(Target, In Slot, In Default Value)
functions.docs: Get the slot's shrink size value, applicable if the size rule is FillContent.

functions.name: GetMinSize
functions.signature: GetMinSize(Target, In Slot, In Default Value)
functions.docs: Get the slot's minimum size, if set. A value of 0.0f indicates this is not set.

functions.name: GetMaxSize
functions.signature: GetMaxSize(Target, In Slot, In Default Value)
functions.docs: Get the slot's maximum size, if set. A value of 0.0f indicates this is not set.
